STEP 5. Check the front-ECU ground circuit at the front-
ECU connector A-09X.
(1) Disconnect the front-ECU connector A-09X and measure at 
the relay box side.
(2) Measure the resistance between terminal 1 and ground.
Q: Is the resistance less than 2 ohms?
YES : Go to Step 8.
NO : Go to Step 6.
STEP 6. Check the front-ECU connector A-09X for damage.
Q: Is front-ECU connector A-09X in good condition?
YES : Go to Step 7.
NO : Repair or replace it. Refer to GROUP 8W1, Harness 
Connector Inspection P.00E-2. Confirm the DTC 13 is 
not displayed.
STEP 7. Check the harness wire between front-ECU 
connector A-09X and ground.
Q: Is the harness wire between front-ECU connector A-09X 
and ground in good condition?
YES : There is no action to be taken.
NO : Repair it. Confirm the DTC 13 is not displayed.
